cat > /tmp/bookforum-reference/probe.py <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/tmp/bookforum-reference/cases')
EXE = '/tmp/bookforum-reference/bookforum'
NAMES = ['ACCOUNTS.DAT', 'BOOKS.DAT', 'TRANSACTIONS.DAT']

def account(ident, balance=1000, name=b'Name'):
    if isinstance(balance, int):
        balance = f'{balance:010d}'.encode()
    return ident + name.ljust(20, b' ') + balance

def book(ident=b'B001', owner=b'U002'):
    return ident + b'A book'.ljust(20, b' ') + owner

ACCOUNTS = account(b'U001') + account(b'U002', 2000) + account(b'U003', 3000)
BOOKS = book()
TRANS = b'OLD-TRANSACTION'

def run(label, inp=b'U001U002B0010000000200', accounts=ACCOUNTS, books=BOOKS, transactions=TRANS):
    case = ROOT / label
    shutil.rmtree(case, ignore_errors=True)
    (case / 'src').mkdir(parents=True)
    (case / 'data').mkdir()
    for name, content in [('src/INPUT.DAT', inp), ('data/ACCOUNTS.DAT', accounts), ('data/BOOKS.DAT', books), ('data/TRANSACTIONS.DAT', transactions)]:
        if content is not None:
            (case / name).write_bytes(content)
    result = subprocess.run([EXE], cwd=case, capture_output=True, timeout=5)
    print('\n', label, 'status', result.returncode, 'stdout', repr(result.stdout), 'stderr', repr(result.stderr))
    for name in NAMES:
        path = case / 'data' / name
        data = path.read_bytes() if path.exists() else None
        print(name, repr(data))
    return result, case

if __name__ == '__main__':
    run('normal')
    run('short-amount', inp=b'U001U002B001200')
    run('empty-amount', inp=b'U001U002B001')
    run('short-ids', inp=b'U001U002B')
    run('empty-input', inp=b'')
    run('zero', inp=b'U001U002B0010000000000')
    run('underflow', accounts=account(b'U001', 50) + account(b'U002', 2000))
    run('overflow', accounts=account(b'U001', 1000) + account(b'U002', 9999999900))
    run('same-account', inp=b'U001U001B0010000000200', books=book(owner=b'U001'))
    run('same-account-underflow', inp=b'U001U001B0010000002000', books=book(owner=b'U001'))
    run('duplicate-accounts', accounts=account(b'U001')+account(b'U001',50)+account(b'U002',2000)+account(b'U002',9999999950))
    run('duplicate-books', books=book(owner=b'U003')+book(owner=b'U002')+book(owner=b'U004'))
    run('partial-accounts-tail', accounts=ACCOUNTS + b'U001partial')
    run('partial-books-tail', books=BOOKS + b'B001partial')
    run('partial-books-first', books=b'B001A book              U002'[:27])
    run('accounts-newlines', accounts=b'\n'.join([account(b'U001'),account(b'U002')])+b'\n')
    run('missing-input', inp=None)
    run('missing-accounts', accounts=None)
    run('missing-books', books=None)
    run('missing-transactions', transactions=None)
PY
